sources.title: MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research
sources.read_scope: HTML methods, state programmability, evaluation protocol and limitations passages
sources.scope: Browser-hosted controllable mobile simulation with structured-state judging and screenshot observations
limitations: Paper-level snapshot/fork and real-device claims are not proof that the current local rollout path implements verified intermediate-state replay; author results are not the user results.

sources.title: Agent S2: A Compositional Generalist-Specialist Framework for Computer Use Agents
sources.read_scope: HTML background, method, experimental setup and analysis
sources.scope: Mixture of Grounding and proactive hierarchical planning separate general reasoning from specialist execution
limitations: Multi-model system and action/step budgets differ from a single 4B policy; do not transfer its headline success rates.

sources.title: OS-Genesis: Automating GUI Agent Trajectory Construction via Reverse Task Synthesis
sources.read_scope: Published metadata and PDF method sections 3.1-3.3
sources.scope: Explore transitions, synthesize low/high-level task instructions retrospectively and filter trajectories with a trajectory reward model
limitations: Teacher/model-assisted construction and rich collection-time interfaces need accounting; generated instructions still need executable validation.

sources.title: OpenMobile-2: Building Versatile Mobile Agents with Scalable Environments and App-Native Tools
sources.read_scope: HTML environment, data and hybrid interface; appendix A.1-A.4 training, reward, evaluation and overlap
sources.scope: Scalable simulator/emulator data, GUI/hybrid SFT, and hybrid RL with verifiers; GUI-only vs tool-assisted evaluation
limitations: Hybrid app-native actions change action space; reward includes tool bonus and relaxed verifier whereas strict evaluation differs. Never compare these scores directly with pure screenshot-coordinate policy scores.

sources.title: WM-R1: Training GUI Agents to Reason and leverage World Models with Reinforcement Learning
sources.read_scope: HTML methods, world-model configuration, evaluator/reward passages and limitations
sources.scope: World-model transitions and optional model calls during reasoning, coupled to GRPO and composite reward
limitations: Frozen Code2World generates rendered HTML and model judges reward; learned-transition error and judge error remain. Do not treat simulated transitions as exact business-state execution or claim zero total cost.

sources.title: Policy Invariance Under Reward Transformations: Theory and Application to Reward Shaping
sources.read_scope: Original PDF theorem and potential-shaping setup; source mirror used after Stanford timeout
sources.scope: Potential difference F(s,a,s_next)=gamma*Phi(s_next)-Phi(s) under specified MDP conditions
limitations: Discount and terminal boundary conditions matter; statement does not make arbitrary process bonuses policy-invariant.

sources.title: AndroidWorld: A Dynamic Benchmarking Environment for Autonomous Agents
sources.read_scope: 全文可访问；实际核读 §3.1–3.4、Appendix A 的相关段落，非逐页通读
sources.scope: 固定 Android 13 / Pixel 6 emulator，真实 Android 应用；116 个可参数化任务，20 个应用。
limitations: 应用以开源和系统应用为主，固定版本、无登录与本地数据是复现条件；参数变化会影响结果。Android emulator 不等于物理真机。

sources.title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
sources.read_scope: 全文可访问；实际核读 §2–3、§5.2 的相关段落，非逐页通读
sources.scope: 虚拟机中的真实桌面 OS；主基准 369 个 Ubuntu 任务，另有 43 个 Windows 任务，不是 369 个任务均覆盖所有 OS。
limitations: 截图分辨率、历史长度、a11y/SoM、代码动作与步数预算改变难度和成本。

sources.title: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents
sources.read_scope: 全文可访问；实际核读 §2–3，包括 Docker/reset 说明，非逐页通读
sources.scope: 自托管网站，四类主要业务网站，另有地图/Wikipedia 等工具；241 个模板生成 812 个任务实例。
limitations: 有状态 oracle 不等于全是确定性规则；ID 动作与坐标动作不同，模板实例不等于独立技能。

sources.title: VisualWebArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Realistic Visual Web Tasks
sources.read_scope: 全文可访问；实际核读 §3 的接口/评测，以及 ACL 官方元数据与论文首页，非逐页通读
sources.scope: 910 个视觉任务，三个主要网站：Classifieds、Shopping、Reddit；25.2% 任务指令包含输入图片。
limitations: 图像输入不意味着 screenshot-only policy；SoM 降低定位难度且依赖提取器，视觉 judge 也需验证。

sources.title: On the Effects of Data Scale on UI Control Agents
sources.read_scope: 全文可访问；实际核读 §3–5 的数据划分、基线、指标与局限段落，非逐页通读
sources.scope: 15,283 条演示、14,548 个唯一任务、833 个应用；高层目标与低层逐步指令。
limitations: 离线评测不奖励新有效路径或纠错；只微调 PaLM-2S，数据规模外推不是实际在线完成率。

sources.title: ScreenSpot-Pro: GUI Grounding for Professional High-Resolution Computer Use
sources.read_scope: 全文可访问；实际核读 §3–4 相关段落及官方 evaluator 的 eval_sample_positive_gt/calc_metric_for_result_list
sources.scope: 1,581 个指令/截图样本，23 个应用、三个 OS；面向高分辨率与小目标。
limitations: 多轮裁剪增加推理预算；图标/文字、分辨率、语言版本和标注边界影响可比性。

sources.title: OSWorld 2.0: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on Long-Horizon Real-World Tasks
sources.read_scope: 全文可访问；实际核读 §2.1–2.2、§3.1、§4.4，非逐页通读
sources.scope: 108 个长工作流；真实桌面配自托管服务、任务状态、可配置用户回答和动态更新。
limitations: 终局 checkpoint 部分分不是时间逐步 PRM；受控服务仍不等于开放互联网，部分分与严格完成须区分。

sources.title: SeeClick: Harnessing GUI Grounding for Advanced Visual GUI Agents
sources.read_scope: 3.1–3.3; 4; 5.2; appendix training/task definitions
sources.scope: grounding, offline step prediction, online MiniWob; distinguish benchmark-specific task success
category: supervised grounding continual pretraining and downstream adaptation
limitations: Grounding and offline step accuracy are distinct from complete online task success; MiniWob results do not establish broad mobile GUI generalization.

sources.title: Navigating the Digital World as Humans Do: Universal Visual Grounding for GUI Agents
sources.scope: grounding, cached-state offline agent, live mobile/web agent
category: supervised visual grounding; separate planner in SeeAct-V
limitations: A modular planner/grounder system is not a single-policy ablation; cached-state and live-environment results have different scopes.

sources.title: ShowUI: One Vision-Language-Action Model for GUI Visual Agent
sources.read_scope: 2.1–2.3; 3.2–3.3; 5 limitation; appendix B
sources.scope: ScreenSpot grounding; AITW/Mind2Web step metrics; online MiniWob
category: offline instruction tuning and downstream supervised adaptation
limitations: Offline instruction tuning and supervised adaptation are not evidence of online RL; image-history settings and step/task metrics vary by dataset.

sources.title: UI-TARS: Pioneering Automated GUI Interaction with Native Agents
sources.read_scope: 3 core capabilities; 4.2–4.6; 5.4; 2.3 future active/lifelong perspective
sources.scope: perception/grounding/offline step plus live OSWorld/AndroidWorld; separate 15/50 step budgets
category: continual pretraining, annealing/SFT, reflective correction SFT and Agent DPO
limitations: Reflective SFT and Agent DPO differ from online PPO/GRPO; online results require the stated model, action interface, and 15/50-step budgets.

sources.title: UI-TARS-2 Technical Report: Advancing GUI Agent with Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
sources.scope: online GUI/game; some benchmarks allow SDK/terminal; dagger in table 1 marks extended action space
category: CT/SFT/data iteration and multi-turn online PPO; critic/value pretraining
limitations: Some evaluations permit SDK/terminal or extended action spaces; do not compare those scores directly with pure screenshot-coordinate policies.

sources.title: InfiGUI-R1: Advancing Multimodal GUI Agents from Reactive Actors to Deliberative Reasoners
sources.scope: ScreenSpot/ScreenSpot-Pro and AndroidControl; do not convert offline step correctness into closed-loop task success
limitations: Teacher-side accessibility information and annotated subgoals are training inputs; offline step correctness does not establish closed-loop long-horizon task success.

sources.title: GUI-R1 : A Generalist R1-Style Vision-Language Action Model For GUI Agents
sources.scope: offline grounding/action type/step success metrics over eight datasets
category: GRPO on sampled action responses with ground-truth rule rewards; separate supervised baseline
limitations: Rule-reward optimization is evaluated mainly through offline grounding/action/step metrics; these are not end-to-end online task success.

sources.title: ProgRM: Build Better GUI Agents with Progress Rewards
sources.read_scope: Sections 2.1–2.4; Sections 3.1–3.3 and Tables 1–3; Appendices A–D selected method/data passages; Appendix action prompts
sources.scope: Qwen2.5-7B, WikiHow GUI screen representation with element_id action interface; not established as pure screenshot coordinate control
limitations: Single app/task suite, 427 train / 150 test tasks.
Environment-derived labels outperform LCS labels.
Action matching depends on symbolic action/element representation; necessary waits and reversible paths complicate transfer.
Appendix B uses manual successful trajectories where exploration found none; automatic labels do not imply a wholly annotation-free pipeline.

sources.title: GUI-Shepherd: Reliable Process Reward and Verification for Long-Sequence GUI Tasks
sources.read_scope: Section 3; Sections 4.1–4.3, Algorithms 1–2; Section 5 and Table 1; Appendix A.3 and online PPO details
sources.scope: Screenshot-conditioned GUI actions; UI-TARS-1.5-7B; AndroidWorld online and AndroidControl offline
limitations: 52k human correctness labels and a separate reward service/value model are substantial costs.
Online PPO and inference verification are separate treatments.
Per-action human correctness is a different target from state progress or future success probability.

sources.title: Guiding VLM Agents with Process Rewards at Inference Time for GUI Navigation
sources.read_scope: Sections 3.1–3.3; Sections 4.2–4.3; Section 5, Tables 2–5
sources.scope: VLM + screenshot with Set-of-Marks; static AitW/GUI Odyssey/Mind2Web and dynamic AitW
limitations: Extra candidate/reward-model inference and SoM interface alter budget and observation contract.
71.6% uses retries and is not one-attempt policy pass@1.

Reported dynamic aggregate 58.1 is not reproduced by equal-weight mean of listed domain cells (~56.4), despite text describing 30 tasks/domain; retain as paper-reported rather than independently reconstructed.

sources.title: Group-in-Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
sources.read_scope: Sections 4.1–4.3, Equations 4–9; Sections 5.2, 5.5–5.6; Appendix E.3
sources.scope: Main: text ALFWorld, WebShop, search QA. Appendix E.3: RGB+instruction Sokoban and EZPoints with Qwen2.5-VL-3B.
limitations: Requires equivalent states and enough repeated states with informative return differences.
Memory/history and remaining horizon matter for a GUI agent; screen or route equality alone may be insufficient.
No additional LLM rollout cost is a paper setup property, not a guarantee for state reconstruction or MobileGym instrumentation.
Cannot say the paper only tests text; cannot say it has already verified mobile GUI.

sources.title: AgentPRM: Process Reward Models for LLM Agents via Step-Wise Promise and Progress
sources.read_scope: Sections 3.2–3.3; Sections 4.1–4.2 and Tables 1, 3; Section 5.2; Appendix C
sources.scope: LLM agent tasks WebShop/BabyAI/TextCraft, plus math; not pure-vision mobile GUI
limitations: Appendix C does not use each step's PRM output as a dense PPO reward.
Q_t-Q_(t-1) interpretation uses sparse reward and deterministic transition assumptions in Section 3.2.2.
MC baseline labels whether any continuation succeeds, not the empirical mean success probability.
Do not conflate with Choudhury's 2025-02 paper Process Reward Models for LLM Agents: Practical Framework and Directions, arXiv:2502.10325.

sources.title: WebRL: Training LLM Web Agents via Self-Evolving Online Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
sources.read_scope: Sections 2.1–2.2, Equations 1–6; Appendix B.1 observation/action contract
sources.scope: HTML text plus instruction/action history and element IDs, WebArena-Lite
limitations: HTML/element-ID state contract differs from screenshot-only GUI.
Task generation, ORM, replay, and optimizer changes are bundled; benefit is not attributable solely to reward density.
Synthetic tasks need solvability and train/heldout leakage checks.

sources.title: DigiRL: Training In-The-Wild Device-Control Agents with Autonomous Reinforcement Learning
sources.read_scope: Sections 3–4.3; Section 5 setup and Table 1 vicinity
sources.scope: Last two screenshots, Android emulator, AutoUI-Base; AitW General/Web Shopping
limitations: Frozen image encoder and small MLP value heads differ from full 4B VLM RL.
Live ecosystem stochasticity and an imperfect VLM evaluator differ from deterministic MobileGym state judge.
A learned value estimator can assign step credit without a dense environment reward; this is not a PRM annotation pipeline.

sources.title: MobileRL: Online Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Mobile GUI Agents
sources.read_scope: Sections 2.1–2.2; Sections 3.1–3.3, Tables 1–2 and Figure 3; Appendices C, D.5 evaluation details, E limitations
sources.scope: Screenshot + XML UI hierarchy, bounding-box actions; AndroidWorld/AndroidLab
limitations: XML-based grounding is explicitly acknowledged as a limitation.
SFT data and RL/data/model settings differ; headline gains cannot be assigned solely to AdaGRPO.
FCF eventually removes persistently failing tasks; this can sacrifice hard-task coverage.
Formal ICLR2026 PDF attempted but browser verification blocked; no claim to have read final publisher PDF.

sources.title: UI-R1: Enhancing Efficient Action Prediction of GUI Agents by Reinforcement Learning
sources.version: arXiv v5 (2025-05-24), AAAI2026 publication metadata and PDF opening
sources.read_scope: arXiv Section3.2 reward and Section4 action metrics; official AAAI metadata/abstract/PDF opening, not a full final-version comparison
sources.scope: Rule-based action-type, coordinate-in-box, and output-format reward for single-step GRPO. Useful as a grounding calibration branch, not end-to-end temporal credit evidence.
limitations: arXiv v5:136 selected examples, reported ScreenSpot gain22.1 and AndroidControl12.7. AAAI page:2K data, gains18.3 and10.9. Do not mix sample size or results across versions.

workflow_sources.title: Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents
workflow_sources.read_scope: Metadata and abstract; workflow attribution only
workflow_sources.scope: literature-review procedural workflow; not GUI method evidence
limitations: Excluded from core/supplementary research counts and method-effectiveness evidence.
